residual_risk: docs/wiki/features/review-loop.md and docs/wiki/features/tracks.md went stale again after rebasing onto main, from #197's gc.js/board.js changes -- unrelated to this task's scope, left for #197's owner

repairLaunchHooks' drop-pin heuristic only matches when the pin is byte-for-byte the default minus literal --model/--effort tokens; a pin with any other custom flag falls back to the insert repair, which is the documented behaviour but worth knowing if a reviewer expected broader matching

results.summary: hkb init now repairs a claude launch pinned before the hooks moved onto it (#144): repairLaunchHooks (src/init.js), called right after boardProfiles, inserts {hook_settings} after --disallowedTools or drops a launch that only added literal --model/--effort (moving those into the profile's model/effort fields), printing one line per profile touched and staying silent once nothing is stale. staleHookLaunches moved from src/doctor.js to src/board.js so init can share the question doctor only reported; doctor re-exports it. loadBoard now refuses effort at load time (exit 2) on any profile whose launch[0] isn't claude, naming the profile and its harness -- claude-action is the documented exception (accepted, ignored). Added a spawnWorker test that pins --effort end to end. docs/harnesses.md documents the required launch placeholders and the refusal. Re-stamped the wiki pages that went stale from the board.js/doctor.js/init.js edits (only features/hook-install-shapes.md needed real content changes).
